name: ctxbar
description: The context window as one row above the prompt, a colour per category, opened by the plan's weekly usage with its reset countdown; hover a segment or a figure for its name. While work runs, a running bar with a lane per task (turn, background shells, subagents). Steps aside while another mod draws above the prompt. /ctxbar shows or hides it. A task icon closes both rows and opens a task pane over the /todo list (folders, add, tick, rename, reorder, delete); /ctxbar tasks opens it at any width. With the ensemble mod loaded and a ledger here, an Ensemble icon just before it opens that mod's pane.

pillMaxWidth.title: Task pill: widest (px)
pillMaxWidth.description: The widest a running task's pill gets, its padding included; longer task names end in '…'. Kept between room for a short name and its count (36 plus twice the padding) and 400.

pillPadding.title: Task pill: padding (px)
pillPadding.description: Room either side of a running task's name in its pill. Kept between 0 and 24.

waveSeconds.title: Lane wave: seconds a crossing
waveSeconds.description: How long the wave of re-scattering dots takes to cross a running task's trail, from its start to the pill; fewer seconds is faster. Kept between 2 and 30.
